title: package-website
responsibility: Packages the built website and report command into dist/reports and emits the console-ui assets entry for console hosts.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown as new Error('Report CLI bundle failed.') when the Bun.build result for packages/reports/src/cli/index.ts has success set to false, after dist/reports is cleared and the packages/reports build and dist folders are copied into it and before the console assets are read. Other failures are not listed here: rejections from the awaited filesystem and Bun.build calls are not caught and propagate out of the module unchanged.
